verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the admin dashboard being described as a place for "tracking cap table activity," plus a mention of "complete cap table history," which hints at some activity record but does not describe an audit log. missing for 10: documented change-level audit log, actor attribution (who), field-level change detail (what), timestamps (when), authorization/approval linkage (e.g., board consent), audit log export, independent corroboration.
